<tool_call>
{"tool": "read", "args": {"path": "inputs/example.csv"}}

- {"read": {"path": "inputs/example.csv"}}

<tool_call>
{"tool": "...", "args": {...}}

This pipeline report documents the comprehensive mobility and livability benchmarking analysis performed across multiple European cities. # Input data

The pipeline ingested data from four primary sources including the European Mobility Catalog sample containing 12,315 bytes of mobility dataset metadata, Eurostat city values sample with 657,649 bytes of indicator measurements, GTFS transit feeds from Alicante area with 28,532 bytes compressed sample, and Wikidata points of interest sample with 12,524 bytes of POI data. # Methods

The analysis methodology involved multi-stage data processing including indicator selection from Eurostat dataset, GTFS feed validation and cleaning, POI extraction from Wikidata, and cluster analysis using k-means clustering on accessibility metrics. Accessibility scores were computed based on nearest POI distance, number of departing routes, and route density. The pipeline generated intermediate outputs including cleaned stop data, service intensity metrics, and city-cluster assignments to support the final benchmarking results.
